summary: Verified live Paxity payment integration end-to-end. Root-cause fix (transaction.paxity.io + /transaction/pay-in-mobile) is confirmed working. Backend diagnostic returns http_status=200 with 'SHOPPING EN CHINE' in preview; WAVESN payin returns pending + real pay.wave.com link + base64 QR; OTP enforcement for OMSN works; validation errors (unknown method, amount 0) return proper French 400s; tracking regression returns tracking_step='ordered' + payment_status='pending'. Frontend checkout happy path completes: address -> shipping -> Wave Sénégal -> Payer -> pending screen renders 'Payer maintenant' button + QR image, no blank screen or crash.
critical_code_review_comments: paxity_router.py is ~654 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting models, status mapping, and HTTP helpers into a submodule as it grows.

In diagnostic(), auth_test_status/auth_test_body are only populated when http_reachable AND PAXITY_CONFIGURED — cosmetic redundancy since a preview is already exposed via http_status/response_preview.

Checkout.jsx pending screen: the <a> inside Button asChild inherits data-testid='paxity-payment-link-btn' (correct), but there's no separate testid on the outer wrapper — fine, just a note for future test authors.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 tests, one skipped only because of xdist worker isolation — passed cleanly in serial run)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (checkout -> pending screen with Wave link + QR)

test_credentials: N/A (Paxity live merchant keys already in backend/.env - not modified)
seed_data_creation: One real WAVESN pending transaction created on live Paxity merchant account (amount=100 XOF, order prefixed 'ord_'). Kept to a single call per instruction. One OMSN+OTP call also made (Paxity may have accepted or 4xx'd — verified our OTP guard doesn't block).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Paxity integration is fully working. Do NOT loop payin calls (each creates a real pending transaction on merchant account). Use test_paxity_live.py for regression; it's safe (no .env mutation). Diagnostic uses read-only balance endpoint so it can be called freely. Public URL used: https://paxity-payment-web.preview.emergentagent.com. Test script for pending screen: after clicking Payer, wait_for_selector('[data-testid="paxity-payment-link-btn"]', timeout=30000) — the element IS an <a> tag (Button asChild), so read href directly on it, not on a child.
